mapper.select: SELECT t.title, t.description, t.price, t.category, t.level, t.total_score AS totalScore, t.average_rating AS averageRating, t.trainee_count AS traineeCount, e.progress FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON e.training_id = t.training_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT r.routine_id AS routineId, r.title, rr.status AS completed, rr.submitted_at AS completedAt FROM routines r JOIN routine_results rr ON r.routine_id = rr.routine_id JOIN enrollments e ON rr.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE r.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT t.training_id AS trainingId, t.title AS title, u.username AS trainerName, t.average_rating AS averageRating, t.trainee_count AS traineeCount, t.price AS price, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, t.level AS level, t.category AS category FROM trainings t JOIN users u ON t.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE t.approval_status = '승인' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.title, t.description, t.price, t.category, t.level, t.average_rating AS averageRating, t.trainee_count AS traineeCount, u.username AS trainerNickname, u.user_profile_url AS trainerProfileUrl, t.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl FROM trainings t JOIN users u ON t.trainer_id = u.user_id WHERE t.training_id = #{trainingId} AND t.approval_status = '승인'
